daily_telegram_learning_brief.body:
Qadam scanned 37 data sources against 21 watched markets and found 5 candidate patterns today. The reads: oil shipping/GPS/fire/flight vs CL=F, BZ=F, USO and XLE; silver rates, trade and mining flow vs SI=F, SLV, SIL and PAAS; semiconductors export/news, filings, patents, GitHub and transport vs SMH, SOXX, NVDA, AMD, TSM and ASML; prediction markets Polymarket/Kalshi odds vs news/social/conflict; defence stocks conflict, maritime/flight, GPS and filings vs ITA, XAR, LMT, RTX and NOC.

The learning stays cautious with 1 validated edges; all 5 still need thirty-day persistence. Qadam is checking whether inputs arrive before price or odds move. Source scan, lead-lag, confirmation, adversarial review, paper safety and the quantum core gate passed on qiskit aer local. This can raise watch priority only, not create a paper order, risk approval, execution approval or live-capital signal.

telegram_message.body:
Today Qadam reviewed all connected source activity against the markets it is watching: Oil, Silver, Semiconductors, Prediction markets, Defence stocks. It has 5 candidate patterns under observation, but none of them is being treated as a finished edge yet. The useful part is the daily discipline: Qadam is checking whether named source families repeatedly appear before price or probability moves, instead of reacting to one-off headlines.

The quantum review is a core part of that process. For 2026-07-19, the quantum layer is recorded as ok using qiskit_aer_local_circuit on qiskit_aer_local. These findings can refine the paper strategy toward the 60-day portfolio growth goal, but they cannot approve or place trades by themselves.

daily_telegram_learning_brief.body:
Qadam scanned 37 data sources against 21 watched markets and found 5 candidate patterns today. The reads: oil shipping/GPS/fire/flight vs CL=F, BZ=F, USO and XLE; silver rates, trade and mining flow vs SI=F, SLV, SIL and PAAS; semiconductors export/news, filings, patents, GitHub and transport vs SMH, SOXX, NVDA, AMD, TSM and ASML; prediction markets Polymarket/Kalshi odds vs news/social/conflict; defence stocks conflict, maritime/flight, GPS and filings vs ITA, XAR, LMT, RTX and NOC.

The learning stays cautious with 1 validated edges; all 5 still need thirty-day persistence. Qadam is checking whether inputs arrive before price or odds move. Source scan, lead-lag, confirmation, adversarial review, paper safety and the quantum core gate passed on qiskit aer local. This can raise watch priority only, not create a paper order, risk approval, execution approval or live-capital signal.

active_lenses.claim: Belief systems and mass narratives can function as coordination technology, shaping attention, fear, risk appetite, and institutional permission.
active_lenses.evidence_boundary: Private prior only; cannot affect signal confidence without live-source corroboration.
active_lenses.mechanism: Narratives compress complex power relationships into emotionally legible stories that can move behaviour before hard data arrives.
observable_signatures: synchronized language shifts across news and social feeds
market repricing before official data confirms the story
gap between physical-world indicators and public narrative intensity

active_lenses.claim: Institutions may frame self-preservation as public necessity, creating blind spots in official explanations during stress events.
active_lenses.evidence_boundary: Private prior only; cannot affect signal confidence without live-source corroboration.
active_lenses.mechanism: Organizations protect legitimacy, funding, and continuity; official accounts can lag or soften inconvenient operational reality.
observable_signatures: policy language shifts after market stress
official statements contradicting flow or satellite evidence

active_lenses.claim: The visible political order sits on deeper flows of energy access, security guarantees, dollar liquidity, shipping routes, and institutional control.
active_lenses.evidence_boundary: Private prior only; cannot affect signal confidence without live-source corroboration.
active_lenses.mechanism: Financial, military, and energy systems reinforce one another; stress in one layer can reveal who depends on whom.

active_lenses.claim: A US-China bargain could trade financial-market access, Treasury/stablecoin demand, chip constraints, energy access, Taiwan posture, and Iran pressure into one macro settlement.
active_lenses.evidence_boundary: Private prior only; cannot affect signal confidence without live-source corroboration.
active_lenses.mechanism: Great-power bargaining can bundle apparently separate files when each side needs monetary, energy, technology, and security concessions.

active_lenses.claim: Informal elite networks, private incentives, and ritualized trust systems can coordinate outcomes before formal institutions disclose them.
active_lenses.evidence_boundary: Private prior only; cannot affect signal confidence without live-source corroboration.
active_lenses.mechanism: Small trusted networks can create early alignment, while public institutions later formalize or rationalize the decision path.
observable_signatures: policy leaks followed by market positioning
repeated actor overlap across apparently separate events

paperops_active_paper_trading_automation.boundary: PT-8 binds the hourly PaperOps automation to active Alpaca paper trading. inputs: Configured public and private read-only data providers
stages.key_question: What changed in the world or the markets?
stages.label: Observe the World
stages.plain_english: Qadam watches independent world and market sources for changes worth recording.
stages.safety_boundary: Sources can inform research but cannot create trades or satisfy authority alone.

stages.key_question: Is the information reliable, timely, and relevant to a watched market?
stages.label: Qualify the Evidence
stages.plain_english: Qadam checks whether an observation is timely, trustworthy, point-in-time safe, and relevant to a watched market.
stages.safety_boundary: Qualified evidence remains research input and is not a trade candidate.

stages.key_question: Is there a repeatable relationship worth investigating?
stages.label: Discover Patterns
stages.plain_english: Qadam searches for distinct relationships that repeat across sources, prices, assets, and market regimes.
stages.safety_boundary: A pattern is research evidence, not a probability, strategy approval, or order.

stages.key_question: How could this pattern become a disciplined trading approach?
stages.label: Form Strategy Hypotheses
stages.plain_english: Qadam turns a supported pattern into a testable trading idea with instruments, invalidation, lineage, and risk logic.
stages.safety_boundary: A strategy hypothesis is not a qualified setup or execution approval.
sub_stages: Propose an emerging strategy when needed
Define instruments, invalidation, and risk concept

stages.key_question: Does this strategy have a repeatable, tradeable edge?
stages.label: Validate the Edge
outputs: Validated, rejected, or still-observing edge record
stages.plain_english: Qadam tests whether a strategy worked repeatedly after costs, risk, holdout checks, and forward observation.
stages.safety_boundary: Backtests and shadow results cannot create orders or paper proof ledger credit.
sub_stages: Graduate, hold, or reject the edge

stages.key_question: Is this idea practical to trade now?
stages.label: Akber's 6-Stage Filter
outputs: Akber pass, hold, or veto with explanation
stages.plain_english: Akber checks whether an evidence-backed idea is practical to trade now, rather than merely interesting.
stages.safety_boundary: Akber pass is not risk approval, execution approval, or an order.

stages.key_question: Is this setup allowed into the guarded paper route?
stages.label: Govern the Decision
outputs: One Router state and, only when clean, a PaperOps handoff
stages.plain_english: Qadam combines portfolio risk and safety gates into exactly one final Router state for each setup.
stages.safety_boundary: Only a clean paper-review candidate can reach PaperOps; no dashboard authority is created.
sub_stages: Route to reject, hold, shadow, repair, or paper review

stages.key_question: What happened to the paper order and position?
stages.label: Execute and Monitor
stages.plain_english: The Python executor submits only through guarded Alpaca Paper and keeps every paper order and position in an unambiguous lifecycle state.
stages.safety_boundary: Paper execution only; no live-capital route or unmanaged broker write exists.

stages.key_question: What did the trade, hold, veto, or research event teach Qadam?
stages.label: Learn From the Outcome
stages.plain_english: Qadam compares what it expected with what happened and records only lessons supported by attributable evidence.
stages.safety_boundary: Only a real closed Qadam paper trade with complete lineage may be considered for the paper proof ledger.
sub_stages: Attribute source, model, filter, and route effects
Separate market outcome from system defect

stages.key_question: Should Qadam change future behavior because of what it learned?
stages.label: Improve and Re-enter
outputs: Approved versioned improvement or rejected proposal
stages.plain_english: Qadam tests a specific proposed change before an approved, versioned improvement can affect the next observation cycle.
stages.safety_boundary: Learning remains proposal-first and cannot silently change code, policy, secrets, or authority.
sub_stages: Apply or reject a versioned change
Return an approved version to Observe

stages.key_question: What changed in the world or the markets?
stages.label: Observe the World
stages.plain_english: Qadam watches independent world and market sources for changes worth recording.
stages.safety_boundary: Sources can inform research but cannot create trades or satisfy authority alone.

stages.key_question: Is the information reliable, timely, and relevant to a watched market?
stages.label: Qualify the Evidence
stages.plain_english: Qadam checks whether an observation is timely, trustworthy, point-in-time safe, and relevant to a watched market.
stages.safety_boundary: Qualified evidence remains research input and is not a trade candidate.

stages.key_question: Is there a repeatable relationship worth investigating?
stages.label: Discover Patterns
stages.plain_english: Qadam searches for distinct relationships that repeat across sources, prices, assets, and market regimes.
stages.safety_boundary: A pattern is research evidence, not a probability, strategy approval, or order.

stages.key_question: How could this pattern become a disciplined trading approach?
stages.label: Form Strategy Hypotheses
stages.plain_english: Qadam turns a supported pattern into a testable trading idea with instruments, invalidation, lineage, and risk logic.
stages.safety_boundary: A strategy hypothesis is not a qualified setup or execution approval.
sub_stages: Propose an emerging strategy when needed
Define instruments, invalidation, and risk concept

stages.key_question: Does this strategy have a repeatable, tradeable edge?
stages.label: Validate the Edge
outputs: Validated, rejected, or still-observing edge record
stages.plain_english: Qadam tests whether a strategy worked repeatedly after costs, risk, holdout checks, and forward observation.
stages.safety_boundary: Backtests and shadow results cannot create orders or paper proof ledger credit.
sub_stages: Graduate, hold, or reject the edge

stages.key_question: Is this idea practical to trade now?
stages.label: Akber's 6-Stage Filter
outputs: Akber pass, hold, or veto with explanation
stages.plain_english: Akber checks whether an evidence-backed idea is practical to trade now, rather than merely interesting.
stages.safety_boundary: Akber pass is not risk approval, execution approval, or an order.

stages.key_question: Is this setup allowed into the guarded paper route?
stages.label: Govern the Decision
outputs: One Router state and, only when clean, a PaperOps handoff
stages.plain_english: Qadam combines portfolio risk and safety gates into exactly one final Router state for each setup.
stages.safety_boundary: Only a clean paper-review candidate can reach PaperOps; no dashboard authority is created.
sub_stages: Route to reject, hold, shadow, repair, or paper review

stages.key_question: What happened to the paper order and position?
stages.label: Execute and Monitor
stages.plain_english: The Python executor submits only through guarded Alpaca Paper and keeps every paper order and position in an unambiguous lifecycle state.
stages.safety_boundary: Paper execution only; no live-capital route or unmanaged broker write exists.

stages.key_question: What did the trade, hold, veto, or research event teach Qadam?
stages.label: Learn From the Outcome
stages.plain_english: Qadam compares what it expected with what happened and records only lessons supported by attributable evidence.
stages.safety_boundary: Only a real closed Qadam paper trade with complete lineage may be considered for the paper proof ledger.
sub_stages: Attribute source, model, filter, and route effects
Separate market outcome from system defect

stages.key_question: Should Qadam change future behavior because of what it learned?
stages.label: Improve and Re-enter
outputs: Approved versioned improvement or rejected proposal
stages.plain_english: Qadam tests a specific proposed change before an approved, versioned improvement can affect the next observation cycle.
stages.safety_boundary: Learning remains proposal-first and cannot silently change code, policy, secrets, or authority.
sub_stages: Apply or reject a versioned change
Return an approved version to Observe

stages.key_question: What changed in the world or the markets?
stages.label: Observe the World
stages.plain_english: Qadam watches independent world and market sources for changes worth recording.
stages.safety_boundary: Sources can inform research but cannot create trades or satisfy authority alone.

stages.key_question: Is the information reliable, timely, and relevant to a watched market?
stages.label: Qualify the Evidence
stages.plain_english: Qadam checks whether an observation is timely, trustworthy, point-in-time safe, and relevant to a watched market.
stages.safety_boundary: Qualified evidence remains research input and is not a trade candidate.

stages.key_question: Is there a repeatable relationship worth investigating?
stages.label: Discover Patterns
stages.plain_english: Qadam searches for distinct relationships that repeat across sources, prices, assets, and market regimes.
stages.safety_boundary: A pattern is research evidence, not a probability, strategy approval, or order.

stages.key_question: How could this pattern become a disciplined trading approach?
stages.label: Form Strategy Hypotheses
stages.plain_english: Qadam turns a supported pattern into a testable trading idea with instruments, invalidation, lineage, and risk logic.
stages.safety_boundary: A strategy hypothesis is not a qualified setup or execution approval.
sub_stages: Propose an emerging strategy when needed
Define instruments, invalidation, and risk concept

stages.key_question: Does this strategy have a repeatable, tradeable edge?
stages.label: Validate the Edge
outputs: Validated, rejected, or still-observing edge record
stages.plain_english: Qadam tests whether a strategy worked repeatedly after costs, risk, holdout checks, and forward observation.
stages.safety_boundary: Backtests and shadow results cannot create orders or paper proof ledger credit.
sub_stages: Graduate, hold, or reject the edge

stages.key_question: Is this idea practical to trade now?
stages.label: Akber's 6-Stage Filter
outputs: Akber pass, hold, or veto with explanation
stages.plain_english: Akber checks whether an evidence-backed idea is practical to trade now, rather than merely interesting.
stages.safety_boundary: Akber pass is not risk approval, execution approval, or an order.

stages.key_question: Is this setup allowed into the guarded paper route?
stages.label: Govern the Decision
outputs: One Router state and, only when clean, a PaperOps handoff
stages.plain_english: Qadam combines portfolio risk and safety gates into exactly one final Router state for each setup.
stages.safety_boundary: Only a clean paper-review candidate can reach PaperOps; no dashboard authority is created.
sub_stages: Route to reject, hold, shadow, repair, or paper review

stages.key_question: What happened to the paper order and position?
stages.label: Execute and Monitor
stages.plain_english: The Python executor submits only through guarded Alpaca Paper and keeps every paper order and position in an unambiguous lifecycle state.
stages.safety_boundary: Paper execution only; no live-capital route or unmanaged broker write exists.

stages.key_question: What did the trade, hold, veto, or research event teach Qadam?
stages.label: Learn From the Outcome
stages.plain_english: Qadam compares what it expected with what happened and records only lessons supported by attributable evidence.
stages.safety_boundary: Only a real closed Qadam paper trade with complete lineage may be considered for the paper proof ledger.
sub_stages: Attribute source, model, filter, and route effects
Separate market outcome from system defect

stages.key_question: Should Qadam change future behavior because of what it learned?

outputs: Approved versioned improvement or rejected proposal
stages.plain_english: Qadam tests a specific proposed change before an approved, versioned improvement can affect the next observation cycle.
stages.safety_boundary: Learning remains proposal-first and cannot silently change code, policy, secrets, or authority.

self_refinement_loop.plain_english: Qadam does not assume this strategy is correct forever. It replays historical examples and asks: when this kind of signal appeared before, did the market usually move afterward?
self_refinement_loop.what_backtesting_teaches: The current whole-universe baseline has 82 complete forward windows and 6150 missing windows. As those windows fill, Qadam can see which signals tended to lead prices and which only explained moves after the fact.
self_refinement_loop.what_can_change_over_time: Qadam may propose better instruments, stronger confirmation thresholds, weaker strategy weights, or stricter blockers.
self_refinement_loop.what_cannot_change_without_review: Backtesting cannot grant trade authority, bypass Akber, bypass Router, bypass PaperOps, create broker writes, enable live capital, or create paper proof ledger credit.
self_refinement_loop.what_gets_tested: Source events, price moves, timing lags, similar historical cases, nonlinear interactions, Akber outcomes, and Router holds.

communications.draft_body:
Qadam scanned 37 data sources against 21 watched markets and found 5 candidate patterns today. The reads: oil shipping/GPS/fire/flight vs CL=F, BZ=F, USO and XLE; silver rates, trade and mining flow vs SI=F, SLV, SIL and PAAS; semiconductors export/news, filings, patents, GitHub and transport vs SMH, SOXX, NVDA, AMD, TSM and ASML; prediction markets Polymarket/Kalshi odds vs news/social/conflict; defence stocks conflict, maritime/flight, GPS and filings vs ITA, XAR, LMT, RTX and NOC.

The learning stays cautious with 1 validated edges; all 5 still need thirty-day persistence. Qadam is checking whether inputs arrive before price or odds move. Source scan, lead-lag, confirmation, adversarial review, paper safety and the quantum core gate passed on qiskit aer local. This can raise watch priority only, not create a paper order, risk approval, execution approval or live-capital signal.

immediate_answer.headline: Waiting for the first complete Qadam paper outcome
immediate_answer.summary: Qadam has recorded research and operating lessons, but it has not yet completed a paper trade with complete research-to-execution evidence that can support an official judgment of its trading decisions. Historical broker records remain available for context only and do not count toward Qadam's performance record. No verified trading lesson exists yet, and any supported lesson must still pass testing and review before it can change the system.

bullets: Strongest lesson: 6 Qadam research or operating events can support cautious follow-up; historical broker mirrors cannot.
Biggest uncertainty: provider history covers 223 of 360 required data slices, and 360 proposed relationships have entered a statistical test.
Next test: fill the eligible historical gaps, then watch qualifying ideas in real time without placing orders; 0 no-order decisions exist now.
latest_brief.source_body:
Qadam scanned 37 data sources against 21 watched markets and found 5 candidate patterns today. The reads: oil shipping/GPS/fire/flight vs CL=F, BZ=F, USO and XLE; silver rates, trade and mining flow vs SI=F, SLV, SIL and PAAS; semiconductors export/news, filings, patents, GitHub and transport vs SMH, SOXX, NVDA, AMD, TSM and ASML; prediction markets Polymarket/Kalshi odds vs news/social/conflict; defence stocks conflict, maritime/flight, GPS and filings vs ITA, XAR, LMT, RTX and NOC.

The learning stays cautious with 1 validated edges; all 5 still need thirty-day persistence. Qadam is checking whether inputs arrive before price or odds move. Source scan, lead-lag, confirmation, adversarial review, paper safety and the quantum core gate passed on qiskit aer local. This can raise watch priority only, not create a paper order, risk approval, execution approval or live-capital signal.
latest_brief.summary: Qadam has not yet completed a paper trade it can use to judge its own decisions. 42 historical broker records remain reference-only.

loop_overview.page_scope: This page covers stages 1-2: what happened and what the evidence supports.

steps.description: A paper result, rejected idea, held setup, missed opportunity, or operating event is recorded.

steps.description: Qadam records only what the evidence supports and keeps reference-only history separate.

steps.description: A specific, measurable change is proposed. Nothing changes yet.

steps.label: Review

category_rows.description: Conflict and geopolitics feeds track wars, sanctions, political violence, and government-risk events that can move oil, defence, shipping, currencies, and prediction markets.
Macro and trade feeds give Qadam the economic backdrop: rates, inflation, trade flows, inventories, industrial activity, and country-level pressure that may change market regimes.
Market feeds provide the direct trading lens: prices, technical context, paper broker mirrors, prediction market order books, options context, and execution-safe market state.
Market-context taxonomy feeds map raw sources into the actual sleeves Qadam watches, so a shipping, energy, chip, defence, or prediction-market signal is routed to the right strategy family.
Physical-world feeds watch real-world movement and constraints: ships, flights, weather, fires, ports, infrastructure, geospatial activity, and supply-chain pressure.
Social, news, filings, and web feeds watch public narrative, attention shifts, regulatory filings, developer/news activity, and human crowd signals that can strengthen or weaken a hypothesis.

human_brief.body:
Qadam scanned 37 data sources against 21 watched markets and found 5 candidate patterns today. The reads: oil shipping/GPS/fire/flight vs CL=F, BZ=F, USO and XLE; silver rates, trade and mining flow vs SI=F, SLV, SIL and PAAS; semiconductors export/news, filings, patents, GitHub and transport vs SMH, SOXX, NVDA, AMD, TSM and ASML; prediction markets Polymarket/Kalshi odds vs news/social/conflict; defence stocks conflict, maritime/flight, GPS and filings vs ITA, XAR, LMT, RTX and NOC.

The learning stays cautious with 1 validated edges; all 5 still need thirty-day persistence. Qadam is checking whether inputs arrive before price or odds move. Source scan, lead-lag, confirmation, adversarial review, paper safety and the quantum core gate passed on qiskit aer local. This can raise watch priority only, not create a paper order, risk approval, execution approval or live-capital signal.

plain_english_terms.persistence: The pattern must keep appearing over real elapsed time before Qadam treats it as stronger evidence.
plain_english_terms.six_stage_trade_quality_checklist: Akber's filter checks context, catalyst, confirmation, risk, execution route, and postmortem learning.

Macro and trade feeds give Qadam the economic backdrop: rates, inflation, trade flows, inventories, industrial activity, and country-level pressure that may change market regimes.
Market feeds provide the direct trading lens: prices, technical context, paper broker mirrors, prediction market order books, options context, and execution-safe market state.
Market-context taxonomy feeds map raw sources into the actual sleeves Qadam watches, so a shipping, energy, chip, defence, or prediction-market signal is routed to the right strategy family.
Physical-world feeds watch real-world movement and constraints: ships, flights, weather, fires, ports, infrastructure, geospatial activity, and supply-chain pressure.
Social, news, filings, and web feeds watch public narrative, attention shifts, regulatory filings, developer/news activity, and human crowd signals that can strengthen or weaken a hypothesis.

telegram_human_brief.body:
Qadam reviewed 37 data sources against 21 watched markets, including Oil, Silver, Semiconductors. It found 5 candidate relationships and 1 confirmed edges. The quantum review is part of the core test; today it came back ok through qiskit aer local, so Qadam can keep checking whether named source families appear before prices or probabilities move.

This means Qadam has material to learn from, but not a shortcut to trade. 5 improvements are ready for human review and 5 are held for more outcome evidence and explicit approval. For the 60-day paper goal, where the account is currently around GBP 99,891 against a GBP 200,000 target, about -0.11% of the way there, Qadam may adjust watch priority, but any paper order still has to pass strategy, risk, quantum, and Alpaca Paper first.
telegram_human_brief.boundary: Telegram Human Brief is an outbound explanatory note for daily edge findings, quantum review, and promotion-gate state. It can summarize what Qadam learned in plain language, but it cannot create trade candidates, approve risk, approve execution, submit or close broker orders, handle Telegram commands, call quantum providers, mutate strategy, expose secrets or chat ids, grant proof credit, deploy code, or enable live capital.

portfolio_goal_alignment.goal: double paper portfolio value over 60 days
portfolio_goal_alignment.strategy_alignment: Daily findings may alter watch priority and research conviction, but paper order creation still requires Qadam strategy, risk, idempotency, and Alpaca Paper execution gates.
